description: The proliferation of small, low-cost Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) poses a significant and growing threat to military and civilian assets. These systems can be used for adversarial intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) or as direct-attack weapon platforms. A critical need exists for a point-defense capability that can be deployed rapidly and affordably to protect fixed and semi-fixed sites, such as airbases, forward operating bases, and critical infrastructure.
